question: Was the individual self stainless prior to the arising of great delusion?
premises: Great delusion is said to arise at some point
A prior condition of the soul is being considered
Stainlessness would mean absence of impurity
inference: The verse presents the view that this individual self was stainless before the arising of great delusion.
uncertainties: Whether this states an accepted position or a view to be refuted depends on context.
plain_english: Before the arising of great delusion, this individual self was stainless.
